text:
Jamie: quick ping — PR up for a tiny change to kv-cache TTL and the batcher heuristic that affects prefetch behavior. Hoping to get an approval / quick perf sanity check before the nightly deploy window (~tomorrow 10:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3342
Sasha: on it. can you paste the perf numbers you saw? any signal on tail latency or mem?
Jamie: ran a local microbench: p95 +4ms on long sequences but ~25% token throughput improvement for short sequences (seq <= 128). memory looked stable in the quick run. full CI perf job is queued.
Rahul: tagging @Liz for kernel eyes — this touches the attn-kernel selection fallback when prefetch misses.
Liz: looking now. curious about the prefetch backoff math you added. do we have a unit test for prefetch collision?
Jamie: added a small integration test in tests/kv/prefetch_collision_test.py in the PR. tiny snippet:
```
# ensure backoff increases with retries
assert prefetch_backoff(3) >= prefetch_backoff(2)
```
ci-bot: build started for commit f4a1b2c
Sasha: running smoke locally, hitting a flaky in batcher path when seqs=1; reproducing now.
Matt: if that flaky is real we shouldn't block the release. can we gate the new heuristic behind a feature flag so we can merge and flip later? :thinking:
Jamie: added a rollout flag flags.kv_prefetch_v2 (default=false) and a config toggle in the PR — if we see issues we can keep it off globally and enable per-canary. updated the PR description with rollout steps.
ci-bot: build passed — all checks green
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled at 2026-06-01T03:00:00Z
Rahul: left a small nit + a question about metric names (prefetch.* vs kv.prefetch.*). otherwise LGTM from infra side if tests stay stable. @Sasha any perf objections?
Sasha: no perf objections after the local runs and the CI perf is clean so far. lgtm from me once the seq=1 flaky is either fixed or behind the flag.
Jamie: thanks all — will merge after one more quick smoke and confirm canary rollout. will ping here if anything changes :pray:
